actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием ближнего боя: +4 к попаданию, досягаемость 5 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 5 (1к6+2) рубящего урона.
actions.name: Cavalry Saber

actions.desc: The dragonborn breathes fire in a 15-foot cone. All creatures in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием дальнего боя: +3 к попаданию, дистанция 80/320 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 4 (1к6+1) колющего урона.
actions.name: Shortbow

traits.desc: While mounted, the dragonborn has advantage on melee weapon attacks against creatures that are Medium or smaller and are not mounted.
